description: SkuDetail rendered for a seeded (uuid-suffixed SKU, A-01) record shows that record's SKU, location, quantity 12 and tracking code in the detail-sku, detail-location, detail-quantity and detail-tracking-code seams inside sku-detail, fetched from the real lookup API
SkuDetail rendered for the A-01 record of a SKU also filed at B-02 shows the A-01 quantity and never the B-02 quantity
SkuDetail for a record filed without a tracking code renders the detail-tracking-code field as a pill pill--not-tracked (detail-not-tracked) reading 'not tracked', not blank or 'null'
SkuDetail renders the detail-par-level field as a detail-not-tracked pill reading 'not tracked' because par level is absent
SkuDetail for a record with a present tracking code but absent par level renders the tracking code value and a not-tracked pill only on par level, judged independently
SkuDetail for an unknown (sku, location) renders the detail-not-found empty-state naming the SKU at the location, parsed from the real 404 response
SkuDetail not-found state renders a detail-not-found-back link to / and no sku-detail field values
